(a) we introduce the first offline RL method to achieve state of the art results on the RLU dataset, which contains 100 Atari games, (b) our method is the first to achieve state of art results on partially observable environments and (c) we introduce new datasets on which our method achieves state of the art, which we hope will spur further research on offline RL in partially observable environments
we introduce an effective solution to the extrapolation errors problem that is applicable to a broad set of offline RL methods.
